name: Create Deal
description: Create a deal in HubSpot. Set **Deal Name**, **Pipeline**, and **Stage**, and put any extra fields in **Object Properties** as HubSpot internal names. Example: Deal Name `InGen Annual Contract`, Pipeline `default`, Stage `appointmentscheduled`, Object Properties `{ "amount": "250000", "closedate": "2026-09-23" }`. Returns the created deal with its id. [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/crm/deals#endpoint?spec=POST-/crm/v3/objects/deals)
